title: The Sap-Council of Helstrom
summary: As the Elder Tree Council gathers in the labyrinth channels between Thorn and Helstrom, an illicit sap-siphoning ring threatens the sacred Sap-Naming Rite at the Elder Root Sanctum.

hook.rumour: Boatmen coming through the labyrinth channels from Thorn say the inner Hist roots around Helstrom are weeping amber into the dark water before the Sap-Naming Rite has even begun.
hook.notice: ELDER TREE COUNCIL OF HELSTROM: Trusted guides needed to patrol the root-channels between Thorn, Archon, and Helstrom before the Sap-Naming Rite.

npcs.name: Warden of Helstrom
npcs.greet: Boatmen coming through the labyrinth channels from Thorn say the inner Hist roots around Helstrom are weeping amber into the dark water before the Sap-Naming Rite has even begun.
talk: The trouble across Helstrom began when sealed dispatches started bypassing Helstrom.
If you mean to help the Elder Tree Council of Helstrom, start by checking the trail between Helstrom and Green Whisper Camp.

npcs.name: Chronicler of Helstrom
npcs.greet: Keep your voice low—everyone at Green Whisper Camp is watching who asks after the old seals.
talk: We traced the couriers from Green Whisper Camp toward Deep Whisper Camp before they vanished into the brush.
Bring any ciphered tallies back to Helstrom so Arch-Speaker Teeh-La can see the proof.

npcs.name: Outrider of Deep Whisper Camp
npcs.greet: You made good time from Green Whisper Camp. The saboteurs have fortified the approaches near Moss Marsh Hist Grove.
talk: Their ringleader is holding the inner chamber at Moss Marsh Hist Grove with a picked guard.
Once Moss Marsh Hist Grove is cleared, return to Helstrom to seal the regional compact.

npcs.name: Speaker of Helstrom
npcs.greet: Arch-Speaker Teeh-La awaits word on whether the crisis in Helstrom has been contained.
talk: The elders of Helstrom have prepared the concord table for your return.
All of Helstrom owes you a debt for standing between Helstrom and ruin.
